why: A 2026 arXiv preprint on 'Equivariant min-max theory and the spherical Bernstein problem in S^4' claims to construct a non-equatorial minimal hypersphere in S^4 (and reportedly infinitely many pairwise non-isometric examples), directly naming and addressing Chern's spherical Bernstein problem; though the S^4 case was already resolved negatively by Hsiang before the snapshot, the general problem remains open for even n>=8 and odd n>=9, and this new work may bear on those open cases or offer a new proof technique relevant to them.
queries: "spherical Bernstein" S^4 case open Hsiang Tomter n=4 6 remaining
